home.title: A Fullstack Developer
home.goal: My goal in life is to achieve as much as possible while maintaining a healthy and loving lifestyle

about.p1: Being born and raised in Stockholm during the golden-age of smartphones, I have always been at the center of technology - a factor that has only piqued my passion more.
about.p2: I began programming at the age of 15, with some basic Python and HTML/CSS. My learning curve wasn't very linear, but since the age of 17 I have been slowly but surely been expanding my knowledgebase trying to integrate myself in more areas.
about.p3: I will always be grateful for my peers who have helped me grow as a developer. Learning the importance of clean code and writing maintainable code has been a core focus of my journey. I see the joy in always being able to improve, I believe no one has perfected their craft, and  I constantly strive to find new areas to improve in.
about.p4: In the future I would like to apply my work where it can help others. My focus has always been QoL since an organized mind is a happy mind. I want to make a positive impact on the world and contribute to a better future for everyone.
